name: n4_px_summary
description: Fetch one .px file (like n4_read_file) and summarize it without returning the XML: media, imported modules, canvases and viewSize, layers, widget and binding type counts, bound ORDs grouped by component (a trailing value slot such as /out stripped), images, included Px files, charts, other ORDs and label texts. Every list is capped at max_items. A file larger than max_bytes is refused, not summarized in part.
